title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.24843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural surrogates for external vehicle aerodynamics are fast alternatives to physics-based computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations. Their foundational limitation is a lack of zero-shot generalization across vehicle classes, which results in an expensive, custom training campaign for each new vehicle design. Similar to pretrained models in other fields, a pretrained surrogate should adapt to a new vehicle class using only a few simulations and stay accurate on its pretraining domain. No prior study has systematically tested this transfer behavior. We conduct a large-scale, controlled benchmarking study on five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates across four independent target datasets. These datasets differ from the source in geometry, CFD solver, turbulence model, and flow conditions. translated_title: 测量与改进车辆空气动力学神经代理模型的迁移能力
translated_abstract: 车辆外部空气动力学的神经代理模型是基于物理的计算流体动力学（CFD）仿真的快速替代方案。其根本局限性在于缺乏跨车辆类别的零样本泛化能力，这导致每种新车辆设计都需要开展昂贵的定制训练活动。与其他领域的预训练模型类似，预训练的代理模型应当能够仅利用少量仿真就适应新的车辆类别，同时在其预训练域上保持准确。此前尚无研究系统地测试过这种迁移行为。我们对五个基于DrivAerML预训练的代理模型，在四个独立的目标数据集上开展了大规模、受控的基准测试研究。这些数据集在几何形状、CFD求解器、湍流模型和流动条件方面均与源数据不同。我们发现，在不到一半的对比实验中，微调这些代理模型优于从头训练，并且会降低代理模型（在预训练域上）的准确性。
tldr: 该论文通过大规模受控基准测试首次系统评估了车辆空气动力学神经代理模型的跨数据集迁移行为，发现微调仅在不到一半的情况下优于从头训练，且会损害模型在预训练域上的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic, large-scale benchmarking of transfer behavior for DrivAerML-pretrained neural aerodynamic surrogates across four target datasets, showing that fine-tuning outperforms training from scratch in fewer than half of comparisons and degrades accuracy on the pretraining domain.
